description: The College of Lore is the home of bards who celebrate magic and nature through storytelling and performance. They collect myths, legends, and tales, preserving history and passing on knowledge.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you make an ability check, you can use your Bardic Inspiration die to add to the roll. You can do this after the roll but before knowing the result.

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.description: You can learn any spell from the spell list of any class. When you gain this feature, choose 4 spells from any classes' spell lists. You learn them and add them to your known spells.

features.name: Peerless Skill (Enhanced)
features.description: When you use Peerless Skill, you can now use your Bardic Inspiration die on saving throws as well.
